acceptance.given: A retained FR-6 evaluation-seed manifest containing the three frozen seed families, including a variant in which one seed omits its explicit missing-label metadata.

oracle.expected: The evaluation-seed validator accepts retained seeds only when each seed carries explicit missing-label metadata, and rejects the omission variant without deriving labels from native evidence, candidate class, or prose.
forbidden: Accepting a seed without required missing-label metadata.
Inferring missing labels from other metadata or prose.
oracle.observable: The S19 pytest selector observes successful validation for an explicitly labelled retained-seed fixture and a validation error for an otherwise equivalent fixture with missing-label metadata removed.

acceptance.then: Each retained seed has validated explicit missing-label metadata.
acceptance.when: When the Toolchain validator validates a retained FR-6 evaluation seed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S19 pytest case against a retained-seed variant that removes only its missing-label metadata; the validator must report the missing metadata rather than accept or infer it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Extend the Toolchain evaluation-seed validation in validate_implementation.py so every retained FR-6 seed requires explicit missing-label metadata; author the S19 test to prove an omitted field is rejected and update the retained-seed manifest with the required explicit metadata.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retained seed identities, provenance, applicability, counterexample-or-absence, classification, and non-authorizing status remain unchanged; rollback removes only the explicit missing-label validation and metadata additions.

slice_hint.state_transition: A retained seed may omit missing-label metadata -> every retained seed carries explicit missing-label metadata and validation rejects omission.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S19 pytest selector proves that a complete retained seed passes this metadata check and that the same retained seed with missing-label metadata removed is rejected without inference.
